heading: What men ask before their first Tuesday.

items.question: Who is Men of Integrity for?
items.answer: Any man who wants freedom from porn, lust or other sexual sin. Whether you've struggled for years or just realized you can't quit on your own, you belong here.

items.question: When and where does the group meet?
items.answer: Tuesdays from 6:30 to 8:00 PM in the Student Center at Christ Community Church, 10825 Harney St, Omaha, NE 68154.

items.question: Do I need to sign up first?
items.answer: No. It's an open group, so you can start any Tuesday. If you'd like to talk first, text Jon at 402-306-0847.

items.question: Is it confidential?
items.answer: Yes. What's shared in the group stays in the group.

items.question: Is this a Christian group?
items.answer: Yes. MOI is a ministry of Christ Community Church. We believe lasting freedom is found in Jesus, and we pair that with honest community, accountability and practical recovery tools.

items.question: What if I'm not ready to attend in person?
items.answer: Start with the [free self-assessment](https://www.sexhelp.com/) and the resources on this page, or send Jon a text. Taking one honest step counts.
